articles.title: NASA, Boeing still working on Starliner return to flight
articles.summary:

articles.title: Launch to ISS pushed to Thursday over weather: NASA
articles.summary:
Washington, United States (AFP) Feb 9, 2026

 NASA on Monday delayed by one day the journey of four astronauts to the International Space Station (ISS) over weather conditions. 

The US space agency is now targeting February 12 for the lift-off of Crew-12's mission aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, with a window opening at 5:38am local time (1038 GMT).
